name: BankerAlgo
description: An interactive, offline-first educational simulator designed to help students understand the Banker's Algorithm and deadlock avoidance in operating systems. Users can configure processes and resources, edit allocation matrices, follow safety checks step by step, explore core deadlock concepts, and test their knowledge through interactive quizzes.

paragraphs: A polished, modern, highly interactive web-based educational simulator for the Banker's Algorithm (deadlock avoidance) in modern operating systems.

This platform seamlessly replaces legacy console-based desktop Java applications with a premium, responsive, glassmorphic Single Page Application (SPA) designed to help students, developers, and lecturers dynamically study resource claims, thread-safety, and deadlock conditions.
features: Dynamic Sizing: Sliders to dynamically scale processes (1 to 8) and resource types (1 to 5).
Direct Grid Editors: Edit cells for Allocation, Maximum Demand, and Available System capacity instantly.
Auto-Play Intervals & Steppers: Automatically transition step sequences at comfortable intervals, or use backward/forward control buttons.
Live Mathematical Verifiers: Displays dynamic meters comparing Process Outstanding Need indices (Need = Max - Alloc) directly with System Free capacity (Work).
Deadlock Preconditions: Rich breakdowns of the four Coffman conditions (Mutual Exclusion, Hold & Wait, No Preemption, Circular Wait).
